text: THE PRIME MINISTER'S QUOTE IS REBUILT TO THE REFERENCE SHEET OF 25 SEP 2026, with every value taken from the design system rather than from the sheet's hexes and pixels — the two agree exactly on colour, so the card's ground, its hairline, its saffron panel, its quote blue and its two text greys are all published rungs and none of them is a literal. The photograph leads: on the left of the desktop card as a 280x336 portrait crop standing on the foot of its panel, and across the top of the phone card as an inset panel with an edge of its own. The card stands on the brand's palest blue again and takes a NEUTRAL hairline, which also retires the peach one — that had no published rung, and in Figma it was bound to a destructive-action colour that would have turned red in another brand mode. The quotation mark is the design's own vector at the icon scale's 40 rung, solid above the words, where it had been a 128 watermark behind them. The quote takes the headline-2 ramp, the attribution title-2, the event and date body-2, and the action is a large design-system button — full width on a phone. Two things the sheet draws are deliberately NOT built: a "Prime Minister's Message" label, which restates a card that is visibly a quotation from the Prime Minister, and a second source citation beside the one DBIM asks for, which is the link to where the address was delivered.
